reading.review:
Deceptively simple on the surface, The Little Prince reads differently at every stage of life. Through a stranded pilot's encounter with a young traveler from Asteroid B-612, Saint-Exupéry distills friendship, responsibility, and wonder into luminous scenes that linger for decades.

Its watercolor sensibility and gentle irony make it one of those rare short books that rewards rereading every few years.

note.note-text: The fox's lesson on taming — 'One sees clearly only with the heart. What is essential is invisible to the eye.'
Why the rose matters: it is the time spent tending to her that makes her unique among thousands of roses.
